tagline: Watches, held to their own spec sheet.

affiliate.disclosureShort: Affiliate link — we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
affiliate.disclosureLong: As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases. Links to Amazon on this site are affiliate links. Using them costs you nothing extra and does not affect which watches we choose or how we rank them.

price.note: Price shown was correct at the time of checking. Amazon prices change frequently; the live price on Amazon is authoritative.

images.note: 'placeholder' renders a typographic card and never hotlinks Amazon. Set to 'local' once you have dropped your own photos into public/images/watches/{asin}.jpg, or 'paapi' once you have Product Advertising API access.

tiers.title: Under £100
tiers.blurb: The floor. At this money the job is to be honest about what it is.
Where the value density is highest. Most of the list lives here.
You start paying for finishing, movement grade and a real warranty.

tiers.title: Over £500
tiers.blurb: Fewer entries, higher bar. Only things that survive a spec argument.

styles.title: Divers
styles.blurb: Rotating bezel, real water resistance, legible at a glance.

styles.title: Field
styles.blurb: Plain dial, high contrast, built to be read in bad light.

styles.title: Pilot
styles.blurb: Large numerals, long strap, aviation lineage — genuine or borrowed.

styles.title: Dress
styles.blurb: Thin case, restrained dial, fits under a cuff.

styles.title: Chronographs
styles.blurb: Stopwatch complication. Check whether it is mechanical or quartz before you pay.

styles.title: Digital
styles.blurb: Function over romance. Usually the most watch per pound on the page.

styles.title: GMT & dual-time
styles.blurb: Second time zone. Check it is a true GMT and not a 24-hour indicator.
